overview: Mustang Report 19 features student segments on the immune system, a cosmetology paraffin hand treatment demonstration, and opening remarks for the spring sports season.

items.title: Breaking Science: Immune System
items.summary: A student presentation covers the components and functions of the innate and adaptive immune systems.

items.title: Question of the Week Answer
items.summary: The answer to the previous week's question of the week is announced.

items.title: Question of the Week
items.summary: A new question of the week is introduced.

items.title: Cosmetology Shop Paraffin Treatment
items.summary: Nick Keniston reports from the Cosmetology Shop to demonstrate the benefits and process of paraffin hand treatments.

items.title: Spring Sports Address
items.summary: Nick Tucci wishes spring student-athletes good luck and speaks on the character values gained through participation in sports.
